name: Jumping in the City
prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Redesign the square mobile app icon in IMAGE 1 with an entirely NEW CAMERA ANGLE AND JUMP COMPOSITION, keeping the same protagonist and city art style. IMAGE 2 is the exact authoritative character identity and outfit. IMAGE 3 is the authoritative city/environment reference.

CRITICAL ACTION AND GEOGRAPHY:
Show a physically believable running parkour jump SIDEWAYS across the picture, FROM LEFT TO RIGHT, between two neighboring rooftop platforms separated by a modest approximately 1.5–2 meter gap. The runner is traveling toward a clearly visible, broad, solid landing rooftop on the RIGHT, NOT toward empty space or the viewer. Capture him just before touchdown: his forward sneaker has already crossed the destination ledge and is suspended only 30–40 cm above its unobstructed flat top, with the landing surface DIRECTLY BENEATH that sneaker. His rear leg trails back toward the takeoff roof on the left. Torso leans right, knees naturally flexed, arms counterbalance a running stride, head and eyes aimed at the landing zone. An unmistakable takeoff roof at lower left and a much more prominent arrival roof at lower right visually explain the jump. Keep a clear gap between buildings and a real unobstructed landing/run-out area. No railing across the landing path. No impossible midair split, leap into a void, hovering, kneeling or superhero flight.

CAMERA AND EPIC COMPOSITION:
Very cinematic LOW-ANGLE shot looking UP at the runner, from a camera at ankle height just above the landing-roof surface and offset to the side of his path. Three-quarter SIDE profile; the body reads as running horizontally from left to right. Dramatic 22 mm wide-angle perspective, not fisheye. The closest forward black-and-yellow sneaker projects boldly into the lower-right/center foreground, its detailed rubber SOLE clearly visible from below and large through perspective, about one quarter of the image width. The sneaker is still attached anatomically to the natural leg and aligned above the landing surface. Face and torso remain clear in upper center; his full head, hands and both shoes fit with modest edge margins. The hero fills most of the square. Broad textured concrete landing surface visibly occupies the lower-right foreground, extending from beneath the forward foot toward the right edge; slight perspective allows its top to be seen even while the camera tilts upward toward the face. Strong diagonal, huge sense of scale, depth and motion, crisp frozen action.

IDENTITY AND WORLD:
Exactly the adult protagonist in IMAGE 2: tousled dark-brown hair, tan skin, light stubble, dark eyes, charcoal hoodie with hood down and sleeves pushed up, white undershirt hem, black below-knee cargo trousers with yellow straps and pocket tabs, black/yellow wristband, white socks, black/yellow sneakers and white midsoles. Preserve recognizable face and clothing.
Match IMAGE 3: weathered pale concrete roofs, mustard-yellow safety rails placed safely off the jumping path, hints of climbing green plants, modern blue-gray towers, river and distant mountains where the low camera angle permits. Generous BLUE sky and soft white clouds, believable warm late-afternoon sunlight from behind left, golden rim light on the silhouette, cool blue shadows, natural haze. Cinematic premium semi-realistic 3D game art, not a different cartoon style.

OUTPUT:
One finished square opaque 1:1 phone app icon artwork, full bleed. Bold readable silhouette and lighting contrast at tiny icon size; anatomy, actual landing location and jump direction must be visually unambiguous. No text, logo, title, UI, border, phone mockup, extra characters, neon background or blurred protagonist. Retain the realistic architectural city, not abstract building silhouettes. The main improvement is the spectacular low-angle SIDEWAYS jump with large foreground shoe sole and an unmistakably attainable landing roof under the foot.
